decisions.reason: The schlager compilation CD sits close to the firm's long-standing reissue and compilation know-how, so management can read its early sales and adjust it with existing label skills, and it fits the strategy of broadening genre coverage, which makes keeping it in the catalog the sensible choice.

The illustrated release series builds directly on the firm's core competence in carefully produced editions, and as a multi-model product line it lets the firm learn and refine across successive releases, which strongly favours continuation.
